{{Quote|Looks like yer got some bad end of yer latest deal, there, Lookar.|Galliwig, to Loh'khar the Finder|<ref name="Turazza Eggs" />}}
'''Galliwig''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who owned and ran [[Galliwig's Cantina]]. Sometime prior to [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Galliwig encountered the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Loh'khar]] the Finder, a [[free-trader]] who was in possession of three seemingly worthless [[Egg/Legends|eggs]]. Galliwig offered Loh'khar twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the eggs, but the Twi'lek refused the offer. Galliwig watched as the three eggs hatched into baby [[Turazza]]s.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Tell yer what. I'll trade yer those eggs for 25 credits. Take 'em off yer hands real easy like.''"<br />"''I'll pass, thank you.|Galliwig and Loh'khar the Finder|<ref name="Turazza Eggs" />}}
[[File:Lohkhar.jpg|thumb|right|Loh'khar the Finder (pictured) conducted business in Galliwig's Cantina.]]
Galliwig, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], owned and managed [[Galliwig's Cantina]]. At some point prior to the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol]]<ref name="Turazza Eggs" /> around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of {{DarkStryder|adventure=Turazza Eggs|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}} take place four [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the Battle of Endor to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], thus the events of ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'' must take place around [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].</ref> the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[free-trader]] [[Loh'khar]] the Finder conducted business in Galliwig's Cantina. One [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Galliwig approached Loh'khar, who had recently acquired three fist-sized [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] in a business transaction, and commented that the Twi'lek appeared to have gotten the worse end of the deal. Loh'khar replied that, to him, there were no bad ends to any deal, since every one he engaged in was designed to bring in maximum profit for himself.<ref name="Turazza Eggs" />

Confused by the free-trader's statement, Galliwig offered Loh'khar twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for the eggs, which Loh'khar refused. While Galliwig looked on perplexed, the eggs hatched, producing three [[Turazza]] sisters. Loh'khar bonded with the infant [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]],<ref name="Turazza Eggs" /> eventually naming them [[Nizzal]], [[Vizzal]], and [[Rizzal]].<ref name="DarkStryder Campaign">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Galliwig was a human with swarthy looking skin who spoke with a drawl.<ref name="Turazza Eggs" />

==Equipment==
Galliwig wore an [[Clothing/Legends|apron]] while working in his [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="Turazza Eggs" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galliwig appeared in the short text story "[[Turazza Eggs]]" by [[Peter M. Schweighofer]], which appeared in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[1995]].<ref name="Turazza Eggs" />
